newsitem.title: RUSSIA: DIRECTOR OF RUSSIA'S SPARTAK SOCCER CLUB SHOT DEAD.
newsitem.headline: DIRECTOR OF RUSSIA'S SPARTAK SOCCER CLUB SHOT DEAD.

text.p: The director general of top Russian soccer club Spartak, Larisa Nechayeva, was shot dead outside Moscow on Sunday, police said.

A police officer, speaking by telephone from the village of Taratovo, about 120 km (75 miles) east of Moscow, said Nechayeva was killed, along with another woman, when their car came under gunfire. Their driver was wounded, he said, refusing to give any other details.
The police officer said the village where Nechayeva was shot at noon (0800 GMT) contained a complex of country villas owned by the club.

A shocked spokesman for Spartak said he had not heard about the incident. "I spoke to her yesterday at the stadium and she was on top form," said Alexander Lvov, adding that he was not aware of any threats towards her.
Nechayeva, one the few women involved in soccer management, was in charge of the club's finances and sponsorship issues, but Lvov said he had no clues as to who was behind the killing.
"I don't think she could be of interest to criminal structures because our club is not involved with shadowy organisations, we only deal with football."
